_comment: Equity (capital market) Muhurat trading session timings, transcribed only from the exchange's own circular for that year. /stock-market-holidays/ shows a year's timings only when its entry exists here; otherwise it names the day and points to NSE. Times are IST.

rows: Pre-open: order entry (limit-order cancellation only from 14:10)
Closing auction session, for CAS securities
IPO and relisted securities: special pre-open
IPO and relisted securities: normal market
notes: The normal market closes at 15:15 for securities in the closing auction session (CAS) and at 15:30 for the rest.
All trades executed in the session result in settlement obligations.
